_note: Nat_multitask_efficientnetv2_l_v2 (multi-task CNN, trainer train/train_multi_task_cnn.py): EfficientNetV2-L pretrained on ImageNet-21k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k (tf_efficientnetv2_l.in21k_ft_in1k via timm) with two linear heads (crop 55, disease 175). Optimized multi-task configuration: patience increased from 8 to 12 with max_epochs increased to 40 to allow full convergence on difficult disease classes; backbone frozen for epoch 1 (freeze_backbone_epochs: 1) for head warm-up; conservative learning rates (lr_backbone 5e-5, lr_head 5e-4, weight_decay 0.05, warmup_epochs 3, min_lr_ratio 0.01); symptom-preserving crop scale [0.5, 1.0]; head_dropout 0.2; label_smoothing 0.1; effective batch size 32 (16 x 2); grad_clip_norm 1.0.

data._note: Evaluation on test seen (2,000) and test unseen (1,448) across all 333 composition pairs.

model._note: EfficientNetV2-L pretrained backbone with dual linear heads (crop 55, disease 175). Head dropout 0.2 for regularization against long-tail class overfitting.

input._note: 256x256 standardized resized cache with 224x224 center crop for evaluation.

augmentation._note: Symptom-preserving crop scale [0.5, 1.0] avoids cropping out localized disease lesions, with horizontal/vertical flips and subtle color jitter.

loss._note: Joint cross-entropy with label smoothing 0.1 on both heads and equal weighting (1.0 / 1.0).

optimizer._note: AdamW with conservative learning rates (lr_backbone 5e-5, lr_head 5e-4, weight_decay 0.05) to prevent gradient thrashing between the two task objectives.
optimizer.name: adamw

scheduler._note: Cosine annealing scheduler with 3 warmup epochs decaying to min_lr_ratio 0.01 over max_epochs.
scheduler.name: cosine

validation._note: Held-out pseudo-unseen validation (15% split, 20 holdout pairs, max 40 images/pair) sweeping gamma [0.0, 10.0] in 0.1 increments to choose optimal stopping epoch and calibration gamma.

training._note: Patience increased to 12 with max_epochs increased to 40 so the model has enough headroom to escape local plateaus and refine disease feature representations. Head warm-up via freeze_backbone_epochs: 1 protects pretrained EfficientNet weights from initial gradient shocks. Effective batch size 32 (16 x 2). Gradient clipping at 1.0.

evaluation._note: Standard DPD benchmark metrics: Top-1, Top-5, per-class means, and Harmonic Mean (HM).

runtime._note: AMP mixed precision on CUDA with 4 workers. Periodic checkpoints every 5 epochs for resume support.
